title: Uniform C¹_c approximation of a compactly supported continuous function with support control
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with its Euclidean norm |·|. Let f : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Let R ∈ ℝ be such that f(z) ≠ 0 implies |z| < R − 1, and let δ > 0. Then there is a C¹ function φ : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support such that |φ(z) − f(z)| ≤ δ for every z ∈ ℝ^N, and φ(z) ≠ 0 implies |z| < R.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (f : Rn N → ℝ) (R δ : ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ z, f z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R - 1) → 0 < δ → ∃ φ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ (∀ z, |φ z - f z| ≤ δ) ∧ ∀ z, φ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R
